trailhead.label: The church of Valdaora di Sopra (Oberolang), the board’s start

cautions: About 1.9 km on village streets and farm lanes, open to cars and tractors: keep your dog on a short lead.
Narrow path along the Rio Brunst: keep your dog close by the water.
Olang keeps dogs out of the cemetery at the start, the play area and the farmed meadows: stay on the lanes and paths.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.Olang keeps dogs out of the cemetery at: Valdaora vieta i cani nel cimitero alla partenza, nell’area giochi e nei prati coltivati: resta su stradine e sentieri.
